note: Special rotation mechanics per gcsim character (key), written from gcsim v2.50.0's code (paths under internal/characters/). Shown on the Setup screen when the character is in the team.

aethergeo.special: Short hold is its own skill version (the shortest possible hold).

alhaitham.special: Low plunge right after his hold skill; mirrors from his skill power his attacks.
watch: Mirrors are lost when he swaps out.

candace.special: Tap or hold skill; a perfect hold for her ascension 1.

charlotte.special: Tap and hold skills are different moves; the hold can be any length.
charlotte.howTo: tE or hE (the shortest hold) · longer: a time like hE(1.5s) · fE (full hold)

chasca.special: Skill starts her Nightsoul ride: aims become multi-bullet Shadowhunt Shells; skill again ends it.
chasca.howTo: E Aim … E · bullet count: Aim(bullets=4)
watch: Press E to end the ride before swapping, or gcsim waits (up to about 10 s).
No jump during the ride: the run stops.

chevreuse.special: Tap and hold skills are different moves; the hold can be any length.
chevreuse.howTo: tE or hE (the shortest hold) · longer: a time like hE(1.5s) · fE (full hold)

chiori.special: Skill pressed again (needs ascension 1) is a recast that swaps to the next character.
watch: Low plunge only right after a hold skill.

clorinde.special: Her skill state changes Normal Attack and Skill, depending on her Bond of Life.

columbina.special: Charged Attack with Verdant Dew becomes Moondew Cleanse.

cyno.special: His burst changes Normal and Charged Attacks, plunges and skill; skill during burst extends it.
watch: At most 2 extensions per burst.
Swapping out ends the burst.

dahlia.special: Short hold is its own skill version.

dehya.special: Skill again moves her field; burst punches; dash then jump during burst is the kick.
dehya.howTo: E E · Q N… · D J
watch: No jump during the kick: the run stops.

diona.special: Tap and hold skills are different moves.

durin.special: After his skill, Skill again (white) or Normal Attack (black) decides his next burst.

fischl.special: Oz can be re-summoned (recast) while he's out.
watch: A plain E while Oz is out makes gcsim wait until Oz leaves.

flins.special: Skill state: Electro attacks; skill again is Northland Spearstorm, then burst is Thunderous Symphony.
watch: Thunderous Symphony needs 30 energy (gcsim waits).
Swapping out cancels it all.

freminet.special: Normal Attacks after his skill build pressure; skill again detonates.
freminet.howTo: E N N N N E

gaming.special: Plunge right after his skill is Charmed Cloudstrider.
watch: It costs HP.

hutao.special: Her skill (Paramita) changes her attacks; her burst is stronger at 50% HP or less.
watch: Swapping out ends Paramita.

iansan.special: Normal Attack right after her skill becomes her Charged Attack (Swift Stormflight).
watch: Dash and jump cost Nightsoul points.

ifa.special: Skill starts his Nightsoul state: attacks become Tonic Shots; hold skill again is the exit plunge.
watch: Press E to end it before swapping, or gcsim waits.
No jump in Nightsoul: the run stops.

illuga.special: Tap and hold skills are different moves.

jean.special: Tap and hold skills; her C1 needs a hold of at least 1 second.
jean.howTo: tE or hE · for C1: hE(1s) or longer
watch: At C1 or higher, hE alone (the shortest hold) doesn't trigger C1: hold at least 1 s.

kaedeharakazuha.special: High plunge right after his skill is Soumon Swordsmanship.
watch: Use P, not lP: a low plunge after his skill stops the run.

kamisatoayato.special: His skill state turns Normal Attacks into Shunsuiken slashes.
watch: No Charged Attack or plunge during his skill: the run stops.

keqing.special: Stiletto: skill again teleports, or Charged Attack is Thunderclap Slash.

kinich.special: Grapple: Normal Attacks (Loop Shots) fill a 20-point bar; skill on a full bar fires the Scalespiker Cannon.
kinich.howTo: E Fill E (or exact Loop Shots, like E N4 E)
watch: If the bar isn't full when you fire, the app adds Loop Shots until it is (instead of gcsim stopping), and Results says how often that happened.
No Charged Attack or plunge while grappling: the run stops.
Fire the cannon with a plain E: gcsim makes a held cannon 18 frames faster than it really is.
In game a short hold enters the grapple faster than a tap; gcsim times them the same, so E works. A full hold is manual aiming and only adds time here.
Swapping out cancels the grapple.

kirara.special: Short hold is its own skill version (Flipclaw Strike); a hold can also be any length.
kirara.howTo: sE (short hold) · tE · a longer hold: hE(2s) or fE
watch: hE alone is the shortest hold, not the short-hold version: use sE.

lanyan.special: Tap and hold skills are different moves; the hold can be any length.
lanyan.howTo: tE or hE (the shortest hold) · longer: a time like hE(1.5s) · fE (full hold)

lauma.special: Hold skill uses Verdant Dew; Charged Attack turns her into a deer (walk only).
watch: Hold skill without Verdant Dew stops the run.
No dash or jump as a deer: the run stops.

linnea.special: Quick skill presses; the 4th is Lumi Million Ton Crush.
watch: Each press within 0.6 s of the last.

lisa.special: Tap and hold skills are different moves.

lynette.special: Tap and hold skills are different moves; the hold can be any length.
lynette.howTo: tE or hE (the shortest hold) · longer: a time like hE(1.5s) · fE (full hold)

lyney.special: Aim is the Prop Arrow (costs HP, builds stacks); skill during burst ends it early.
watch: No aim right after his 4th Normal Attack: the run stops.

mavuika.special: Tap skill is the ring, hold is the bike; recast switches; the bike changes her attacks; burst needs 100 Fighting Spirit.
mavuika.howTo: tE / hE · recast: E(recast=1) · bike Charged Attacks: C3 F (F = Finisher), with dash cancels C D C D C F · Q
watch: On the bike, a Charged Attack chain ends with the Finisher: write F to do it right away (C3 F). Stopping the chain any other way plays it by itself a moment later.
On the bike, a D between two Charged Attacks is the dash cancel (C D C). For a plain dash there instead, write D(charge_cancel=0).
F off the bike (on her ring) is an ordinary Charged Attack.
Plunge only after a bike jump (W J P) or with Xianyun.
Burst waits for 100 Fighting Spirit.

mona.special: Her dash builds stacks for her passives and C6.

mualani.special: Surfing: moving near enemies gives up to 3 stacks; Normal Attack is the bite (Surging Bite at 3).
mualani.howTo: E Fill N (Fill = keep surfing until 3 stacks)
watch: Stacks come from touching enemies while surfing (time spent moving), not from a number of presses: use Fill.
No Charged Attack while surfing: the run stops.
Swapping out ends surfing.

nahida.special: Tap and hold skills are different moves; hE is the shortest hold.
nahida.howTo: tE or hE (the shortest hold) · longer: a time like hE(1.5s) · fE (full hold)

navia.special: Hold skill aims; hE is the shortest hold.
navia.howTo: tE or hE (the shortest hold) · longer: a time like hE(1.5s) · fE (full hold)

nefer.special: Charged Attack is Phantasm Performance when it's ready; a held Charged Attack is Slither.
nefer.howTo: E C · held (Slither): hC, fC (full) or a time like hC(1s)
watch: Needs Verdant Dew.
Swapping out clears Shadow Dance.

neuvillette.special: His held Charged Attack (Equitable Judgment) can be shortened; sC is an ordinary Charged Attack.
watch: After a shortened C, no Normal Attack, Charged Attack or walk next (use dash, jump, skill or burst).

nilou.special: Three dance steps after her skill; the 3rd step decides the result.
nilou.howTo: E E E (Water Wheel) or E … N (Luminous Illusion)
watch: Swapping out resets the steps.

odette.special: Skill again is Coda (with its own cooldown).
watch: gcsim waits for Coda's cooldown.
Only if her first hit caused a Swirl.

raidenshogun.special: Her burst turns her attacks into Musou Isshin.
watch: Swapping out ends the burst.

sandrone.special: Charged Attack fires beams, limited by her Decoding Power.
watch: Too many beams for her Decoding stops the run.
No walk or jump during her skill: the run stops.

sayu.special: Short hold is its own skill version (one roll and the kick); a hold can also be any length.
sayu.howTo: sE (short hold) · tE · a longer roll: hE(2s) or fE
watch: hE alone is the shortest hold, not the short-hold version: use sE.

sethos.special: His burst turns Normal Attacks into Dusk Bolts.
watch: No aim during his burst: the run stops.

sigewinne.special: Skill has hold levels (1 = short hold); her burst can be shortened.
sigewinne.howTo: tE · hE (short hold, tier 1) · fE (tier 2) · Q(ticks=…)
watch: After a shortened burst, only dash or jump next.

skirk.special: Tap skill is Seven-Phase Flash: her attacks change and burst becomes Extinction. Hold skill absorbs Void Rifts without Flash.
skirk.howTo: tE N… C… Q · hold: hE, fE (full hold) or a time like hE(2s)
watch: No second skill during Seven-Phase Flash: the run stops.
Swapping out ends Flash.

tartaglia.special: Skill switches to melee stance; burst changes with the stance; skill again leaves it.
watch: No aim in melee stance and no Charged Attack in ranged stance: the run stops.
A long melee stance means a long skill cooldown.

varesa.special: Nightsoul: Fiery Passion moves; Normal Attack after her skill is the Follow-Up Strike; a plunge gives Apex Drive, then burst is Volcanic Kablam.
watch: High plunge only after a Charged Attack or with Xianyun.
Volcanic Kablam needs 30 energy (gcsim waits).

varka.special: His skill state changes his attacks; his special skill and Azure Devour need certain teammates.
watch: Needs a Pyro, Hydro, Electro or Cryo teammate.
Swapping out ends his state.

vodyanitsa.special: Her burst is stronger during her skill.

wanderer.special: Skill is Windfavored: everything changes; skill again ends it.
watch: Press E to end it before swapping, or gcsim waits.

xianyun.special: Skill gives up to 3 leaps, then plunge is Driftcloud Wave; her burst lets anyone jump and plunge.
xianyun.howTo: E P, E E P · after her burst: J P
watch: No Normal or Charged Attack during her skill: gcsim waits.
Plunge only during her skill or while airborne.

xilonen.special: Skill is Nightsoul skating: Normal Attacks become Blade Roller.
watch: No Charged Attack or low plunge in Nightsoul: the run stops.
Pressing skill again within 1 s waits.

yaoyao.special: During her burst, dashing or jumping throws extra radishes.

yumemizukimizuki.special: Dreamdrifter: only dash, walk, burst, or skill (to cancel) are allowed.
yumemizukimizuki.howTo: E D… or E W…, E to cancel
watch: Normal or Charged Attack, jump or aim during Dreamdrifter make gcsim wait until it ends.

yunjin.special: Skill has hold levels, and a perfect counter.

zibai.special: Skill is Lunar Phase Shift: Radiance builds; skill again at 70 is Spirit Steed's Stride.
zibai.howTo: E Fill E (or exact attacks, like E N3 E)
watch: If Radiance isn't at 70 when you press E again, the app adds Normal Attacks until it is (instead of standing still), and Results says how often that happened.
Normal Attacks build Radiance faster than waiting (+5 each, besides the steady build-up).
